span.p: LogicalDeletion 枚举: NOT_DELETED(0)/DELETED(1)\n@SuperBuilder 构造\n领域实体继承此类

span.p: ThreadLocal + Reactor Context 双桥接\nSchedulers hook 自动传播\n租户作用域来自受信任认证上下文

div.style: text-align: center; white-space: break-spaces; display: table; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; width: 120px;

span.p:
六池隔离: jdbc(32) cache(4) storage(8)
event(2) remote(16) general(16)
每池可配 virtual-threads=true
禁止直接用 Schedulers.boundedElastic()
